history.note: Fifth detection, magnitude 17.6. Type Ia SN hypothesis strengthened.

last_action_reasoning: CAND_01 at (658, 852) remains clearly visible and continues its brightening trend, with an estimated magnitude of 17.6 in this observation (previously 17.8). This is the fifth detection of the source, and the light curve evolution is highly characteristic of a Type Ia supernova in its rising phase. Weather conditions remain good (17.9% cloud extinction), allowing for high-precision photometry. All other circled regions in the difference image are identified as subtraction artifacts, primarily residuals from bright stars or edge effects. We will continue monitoring Field_Primary to capture the peak of the light curve for CAND_01.
